description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build, integrate and deploy full-stack software for mission-focused systems that coordinate autonomous platforms, working closely with specialists in sensing, AI and robotics. The role spans user interfaces, back-end services and the deployment work needed to run them in production across cloud and on-premises environments.
 What you'll do
 - Build, test, integrate and deploy critical full-stack software for controlling multi-modal autonomous systems.
 - Connect the system to a data platform and to AI, sensor fusion and robotic control components.
 - Resolve practical problems in deployment, integration, security and user experience across cloud, on-premises and hybrid setups.
 - Work with multidisciplinary engineers in sensing, AI, systems engineering, user experience and robotics to deliver well integrated solutions.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 2+ years of professional software development experience, including user-facing full-stack systems.
 - 2+ years integrating and deploying software to cloud, on-premises or hybrid environments.
 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust or Java.
 - Extensive experience with React and TypeScript.
 - Solid working knowledge of integration, deployment, CI and automation tools, APIs, networking, security, authentication and Linux.
 - A university degree in a technical discipline, or substantial practical experience that can stand in for one.
 - A track record of keeping live software reliable once it reaches users.
 - Ability to manage complexity, take initiative and think clearly under pressure.
 - Eligible and willing to obtain a US security clearance.
 - Strong alignment with defense-related work.
 Bonus points
 - Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
 - Experience with real-time data streaming or 3D rendering frameworks.
 - Experience building user interfaces for AI or generative models.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 135,000 to 200,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Life and disability insurance
 - Commuter benefits
 - Relocation assistance
 - Flexible paid time off
 - Paid holidays
 - Paid parental leave
 - Retirement savings plan
 Location and work model
 - Washington, DC, New York City, Palo Alto or Seattle, United States
 - Hybrid, with up to 2 days per week working from home
 - Full-time
 - Travel of 25 to 75 percent, varying by location and team
